Name: Sweet Gem Berry Expansion
Author: TrueYahir
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
It allows the sweet gem berry to be a fruit, and can be used to create wine, jam, dried fruits, and various cooking recipes.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (latest version).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install[b] Content Patcher[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Download this mod and unzip it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Copy the folder [/color]

[code]SweetGemBerryExpansion[/code]
[color=#d4d4d8]into your[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[color=#d4d4d8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Run the game using [b]SMAPI[/b][/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Artisan Goods: [/b]You can now make Sweet Gem Wine, Jelly, and Dried Fruit.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]6 New Cooking Recipes:
[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Sweet Gem Coffe[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Sweet Gem Milkshake[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Sweet Gem Pie[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Sweet Gem Tea[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Sweet Gem Candy[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Sweet Gem Triple Espresso[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Automatic Unlocking: [/b]Once you obtain your first Sweet Gem Berry, you will receive a letter in the mail, and the recipes will be automatically added to your kitchen.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Allow regrowth after harvest: [/b]From cheat menu, you can active an option that lets the sweet gem berry continue bearing fruit every 7 days, allowing it to be harvested again without replanting.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod is a [b]Content Patcher Mod.[/b][/color]
